items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: But 12th and Central was the hangout for all of the musicians. And they had a prominent nightclub, where some of your top entertainers, like Bojangles Bill Robinson played

ctx.x: Did they kind of stick together in a group, or did they...was everybody together?

Not really. But at that time, they had quite a few New Orleans musicians in Los Angeles. And when we'd all congregate here... If you wanted to find any musician in Los Angeles, you could go to 12th and Central, which is the slums now. But 12th and Central was the hangout for all of the musicians. And they had a prominent nightclub, where some of your top entertainers, like Bojangles Bill Robinson played -- it was called the Hummingbird. Of course, Bojangles played the Orpheum circuit.
